thought.text: MinIO has a Linux binary in GitHub releases. Let me download it:

reasoning_content: MinIO has a Linux amd64 binary for RELEASE.2025-09-07 on GitHub. Let's download it from GitHub (codeload/objects.githubusercontent.com will work).

action.command: cd /opt && timeout 300 curl -sSL -o minio "https://github.com/minio/minio/releases/download/RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z/minio.linux-amd64.RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z" && chmod +x minio && ./minio --version 2>&1 | head -2; echo "exit=$?"; ls -la /opt/minio
